source: the stylesheets each document applied (document.styleSheets, in cascade order) during live signed-out loads of lumalabs.ai on 2026-11-18 (/ for the marketing shell, with /pricing, /ray and /about harvested for evidence under their own file names; docs.lumalabs.ai/docs/welcome for the ReadMe hub). Linked CSS bundles plus inline style blocks, re-parsed with CSSStyleSheet. Resolved in probes carrying each surface primary-document sheets: the marketing bundle once with html.light (pricing, about, API, news) and once with html.dark (the class the home hero and /ray paint against), docs once at rest, at 1440 x 900.
